description: This file contains implementation of device context initialization, cleanup, password validation, and request authentication for a home security system, including interaction with a message bus and emulator support.

methods.name: mbus_init
methods.description: Initializes the message bus connection, retries until successful.

methods.name: homesecurity_timeout_handler
methods.description: Handles timeout event to stop home security bridge.

methods.name: HDK_Context_Init
methods.description: Initializes device context, supports emulator mode.

methods.name: HDK_Context_Free
methods.description: Frees device context, optionally saves emulator state.

methods.name: ValidatSecuredPassword
methods.description: Validates password against stored config file.

methods.name: HDK_Context_Authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates request based on username and password.

methods.name: HDK_Signal_Hander
methods.description: Handles signals to stop home security bridge.
